blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Friday said it was confident there would be no riots during the expected protest actions this coming Sept. 21, compared to the violent incidents seen last year. “Malaki ang kumpiyansa natin,” PNP public information chief Col. Allen Rae Co said in a press briefing in Camp Crame. (We have much confidence.) “We have calibrated our security plan and deployment to cater doon sa nangyari, to be able to address better yung nangyari the previous year,” he added.
